headline: Grand Canyon wins at Pitt to extend its season
dek: The shutout win at Pitt brings Grand Canyon to fifteen victories, with only five defeats and two draws all season, and books a trip to Cornell. Every other MW program has finished its schedule, leaving the conference's unbeaten league leader as the only side still playing.
displaced_by: Grand Canyon won at Pitt to reach fifteen wins and extend its season to Cornell

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Scoring and standing run together: every program sits in the conference table exactly where its goals across all its matches put it on this chart.

wire.line: Grand Canyon shut out Pitt on the road and now travels to Cornell as the only MW side still playing.

findings.text: Both matches past their date with no published result are UC Davis home matches from August, against California and Chico State.

next_match.line: Grand Canyon's only away defeat came in its opening match of the season, at Stanford.
